answer.reason: I built the full 120-determinant d3 Hamiltonian (Slater F2, F4 from B=722 and C=3003 cm⁻¹, so C/B≈4.16) plus the octahedral crystal-field one-electron term (eg at +6Dq, t2g at −4Dq), diagonalised it in the Ms=3/2 (quartet) and Ms=1/2 sectors, and assigned spatial irreps from the O-group characters, with quartet contributions removed from the Ms=1/2 spectrum to isolate doublets. The ground state is 4A2g at E=0, and the 4T2g energy of 10.0 and 22.0 at Dq/B=1 and 2.2 confirms the 10Dq relation.
